text:
ravi: Quick announce: we flipped the "latency-optimizer-v1" experiment into a 20% hosted canary at 1749997777. Early telemetry looks promising — notable latency and cost wins. :rocket:

ops-bot: deploy ravi/latency-optimizer-v1 -> canary(20%) succeeded. logs: https://internal.redwood/deploys/1749997777

ravi: Canary vs baseline (same traffic slice): p50 down ~27% (55ms -> 40ms), p95 down ~21% (130ms -> 103ms), p99 down ~18% (360ms -> 295ms). Token cost per request ~13% lower. Overall GPU busy fraction reduced ~7%.

emily: Awesome. Any model-output impact or eval regressions?
avi: No output changes — this is a serving-layer optimizer (microbatching + smarter KV prefetch). Ran full eval suite; all regressions passed. If you see anything odd tag #eng-runtime.

oah: How about long-context behavior?
avi: Long contexts (>=1500 tokens) show minor p99 uptick ~3-5% in some rare routes due to batching alignment; cost still improves. Adding a quick long-context smoke to the canary job tonight.

tia: Rollout plan?
avi: Runbook posted. If canary p99 stays within SLA for 24h we expand to 50% hosted, then 100% in 72h. Rollback flag: runtime.latency_optimizer=false. Toggle command:

```
redwoodctl feature set runtime.latency_optimizer=false --scope=hosted --selector=canary
```

emily: Please cc infra@ and product-sre@ before the 50% flip so oncall can monitor.
avi: Will do. Thanks everyone — big props to the runtime team (Noah, Lena, Arif) for the heavy lifting. We'll post a short econ + perf writeup after 72h. :tada:
